decisive_items: Blood cultures: Gram stain showed thin, fusiform gram-negative rods in two of four bottles
The patient had sustained a dog bite on her right thumb approximately one week before admission.
response.rationale: Bacteremia with fusiform gram-negative rods after a dog bite, plus hypotension and leukocytosis, establishes sepsis, likely Capnocytophaga canimorsus. DIC is less likely given normal fibrinogen and haptoglobin and absent schistocytes; TTP is excluded by absent schistocytes and no hemolysis.

rejected.why: TTP requires microangiopathic hemolytic anemia with schistocytes; peripheral smear showed no schistocytes and haptoglobin was normal.
